cause: Raw worktree bytes were compared with raw Git blobs; valid Git LF-to-CRLF checkout conversion triggered a false positive.
fix: Compare against git cat-file --filters --path expected checkout bytes. Keep original Git blob SHA-256 as provenance and separate checkout hash. Decode text explicitly as UTF-8.

focused_tests.environment: Local temporary Git clones; Windows-style EOL simulated, not a native Windows run
